title: Man Executes Witness for Testifying in Murder Trial
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation into the death of Kenneth Ellis. The 40-year-old New Mexico man was shot inside a crowded Elk’s Lodge just after midnight in April 2024. Investigators pieced together the evidence and realized Ellis was murdered in revenge years after he testified in a murder trial that ended in a guilty verdict. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
